name: vexVRRobotStyled
longDescription: Two-wheel drivetrain with gyro, electromagnet, pen, two front bumpers, front laser distance sensor, front and down eyes, and a location sensor.
longerDescription:
Dimensions

  • Wheel Diameter: 5 cm
  • Wheel Spacing: 12 cm
  • Length: 13.3 cm

Actuators

  • Port A : Left Wheel
  • Port B : Right Wheel
  • Port C : Electromagnet

Sensors

  • Port 1 : Gyro (drivetrain)
  • Port 2 : GPS (location)
  • Port 3 : Touch (left bumper)
  • Port 4 : Touch (right bumper)
  • Port 5 : Laser Range (distance)
  • Port 6 : Color (front eye)
  • Port 7 : Color (down eye)
  • Port 8 : Pen
